headline: Wardens Restore Callahan's Passage as Expanse Toll Mounts
war_summary: Three hours further into the ledger, the map has shifted again. Callahan's Passage, which had yielded a single post by our last edition, is reported wholly back in Warden keeping, at fearful cost: the latest hour's returns top twelve hundred casualties apiece, with the Crumbling Passage and Crumbling Post the most contested ground in the field. The Weathered Expanse has slipped further, one Colonial post fallen to no-man's-land, leaving four posts to the Colonials, one to the Wardens, and four in ruin; Wightwalk alone accounts for thirty-seven of eighty-eight recorded actions, and Warden losses there still outpace their enemy's. Along the Nevish Line the Wardens have recovered a seventh post, leaving the Colonials a single hold, with Blackcoat Way the busiest ground. Mooring County's flags stand as the last edition left them, ten Warden to two Colonial, though its casualty returns have surged anew. Fresh fighting flares in the Gutter about Kuoppa, while in Marban Hollow the Wardens took ground at Mox as this edition closed. Day 553; the demand of thirty-four victory towns remains unmet, and no victor is named.
